reviewer: reviewer step (Claude, separate pass working only from villa.review.json)
packs_loaded: Dubai Building Code 2021, Part K Villas (2021)
UAE Fire & Life Safety Code of Practice (CDGH-OP-25) (September 2018)
ASHRAE 62.2 Ventilation and IAQ in Residential Buildings (2019)

corrections.issue: Mech room holds the water heater and the AHU but has no floor drain: the heater relief discharge and the AHU condensate have nowhere to go.
corrections.reason: Floor drains are required where wet appliances stand (DBC K.10.3.2.3); the code check only looks for sanitary fixtures, so it passed this room.
corrections.fix: Add an fd in Mech, fed by the AHU condensate and the heater relief line.

corrections.issue: No cold water storage tank anywhere in the plan.
corrections.fix: Add a water_tank (with litres for 24 h demand) inside a conditioned room, e.g. Pantry against the W wall with its door moved to the north end, or enlarge Mech.

corrections.issue: The fresh-air unit ended up in the Garage: its outdoor-air intake must not draw from the garage, where vehicle exhaust collects.
corrections.reason: DBC K.10.1.6.4 / ASHRAE 62.2: outdoor air inlets away from contamination sources; the engine moved the unit here only because Mech was full.
corrections.fix: Duct the intake from the E outside wall well away from the garage door, or move the unit to a ceiling void or a larger Mech room.

corrections.issue: Bath 3 and Bath 2 have no outside wall and no window, so their exhaust fans need a duct route or shaft to the outside that the plan does not show.
corrections.reason: Trade interface: exhaust must discharge outdoors without being drawn back in (DBC K.10.1.6.4).
corrections.fix: Show a ceiling duct from each fan to the S facade (through the bedroom ceiling) or a shared vertical shaft.

corrections.issue: The dryer stands in a Laundry with no outside wall, so a vented dryer has no short route outdoors.
corrections.reason: Trade interface: dryer exhaust needs an outside discharge, otherwise moisture stays in the house.
corrections.fix: Specify a condenser / heat-pump dryer, or duct the vent through Maid room's N wall.

corrections.issue: One water heater in Mech serves bathrooms up to about 19 m away (Bath 4): hot water will not reach 50 C within 1 min without a return loop.
corrections.fix: Add a pumped hot-water return (with a pump) to the bedroom wing, or local water heaters for Bath 4 and Bath 3.

corrections.issue: Both outdoor AC condensers sit on the W and E facades with no screen shown.
corrections.fix: Add a screen wall or louvred enclosure around each condenser.

corrections.issue: The DB mounting height is not stated, so the 2 m limit cannot be confirmed.
corrections.fix: Give the panel top_h (for example 1.9 m) in the spec.

corrections.issue: Door hardware for bathrooms (openable from outside when locked) and closets (openable from inside) is not specified.
corrections.fix: Add a door-hardware note to the drawings: emergency-release locks on bathroom doors, child-safe latches on closets.

rules_judged.why: No screening shown around the two condensers (correction 7).
Trap seal depth and primers are not in the bundle; each wet-room drain sits with fixtures that can feed it, Mech needs one (correction 1).
Fan controls are not in the bundle; add the light-switch interlock to the same drawing note as correction 9.
The hood f515vb9 is on the Kitchen N wall, which is an outside wall: a short metal duct with a damper is possible. Duct material is not shown.
